## Setup and Libraries

```{r setup}
#| message: no
#| warning: no

library(data.table)
library(parallel)
library(fda)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```


## Data Loading

We read the combined $L$-cross Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) data from the specified path in the document parameters.
```{r load-data}
input_file <- "/projects/shared/TCGA_data/results/combined_Lcross_KDE.csv"

message("Reading data from: ", input_file)
dt <- fread(input_file)
message("Successfully loaded data with ", nrow(dt), " rows and ", ncol(dt), " columns.")
```


## Functional Data Smoothing

We apply the `fsmooth` function to convert the raw data points into a continuous functional data object.

```{r fda-smoothing}
message("Applying fsmooth function...")
smoothed_Lfun <- fsmooth(dt, M = 6, genLfun.fd = 4, centered = FALSE)
```


## Functional Principal Component Analysis (fPCA)

We perform Functional PCA on the smoothed $L$-functions. Given the number of basis functions ($\text{length}(r) = 70$) and $M = 6$, the total number of basis functions is calculated as $K = 70 + 6 - 2 = 74$.
```{r fpca-analysis}
# Run fPCA
fpca <- pca.fd(smoothed_Lfun$fd, nharm = 10, smoothed_Lfun$fdPar)

# Assign sample names (excluding the 'r_values' column) to the PCA scores
rownames(fpca$scores) <- colnames(dt)[-1]
```


## Unsupervised Clustering

We apply two different clustering techniques on specific dimensions of the fPCA scores (components 1 and 60) to classify the spatial patterns into 6 distinct groups.

### K-means & Hierarchical Clustering
```{r clustering}
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# K-means clustering
fpca_km <- kmeans(fpca$scores[, c(1, 10)], centers = 6)

# Hierarchical clustering (Ward's method)
fpca_hc <- hclust(dist(fpca$scores[, c(1, 10)]), method = "ward.D2")
memb_hc <- cutree(fpca_hc, k = 6)
```


### Cluster Distribution Comparison

Below are the distribution tables comparing the cluster assignments between both methods.
```{r cluster-tables}
message("K-means cluster sizes:")
table(fpca_km$cluster)

message("Hierarchical clustering cluster sizes:")
table(memb_hc)
```


## Visualizations

### Smoothed L-functions Plot

We visualize the smoothed $L$-functions, color-coded by their K-means cluster assignments.

Function to plot the smoothed Lcross functions

```{r plot-l-functions}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

plot_smoothed_Lfun(
  smoothed_obj = smoothed_Lfun, 
  clusters_vec = fpca_km$cluster, 
  mark_i = "neoplastic",  
  mark_j = "stromal",
  center_plot = TRUE      # Subtracts 'r' since centered = FALSE in fsmooth
)

```


### PC Scores Comparison

Finally, we project and compare the sample distributions in the reduced PCA space using both clustering results.
```{r plot-pc-scores}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

# Set up side-by-side plotting layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# K-means plot
plot(fpca$scores[, 1], fpca$scores[, 2], col = fpca_km$cluster, pch = 3, main = "K-means")
abline(v = 0, lty = "dashed", col = "grey")
abline(h = 0, lty = "dashed", col = "grey")

# Hierarchical clustering plot
plot(fpca$scores[, 1], fpca$scores[, 2], col = memb_hc, pch = 3, main = "Ward.D2")
abline(v = 0, lty = "dashed", col = "grey")
abline(h = 0, lty = "dashed", col = "grey")

# Reset layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
